mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ad_statistics (ad_id, ad_title, ad_type, position, stat_date, click_count) VALUES (#{adId}, #{adTitle}, #{adType}, #{position}, #{statDate}, 1) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE click_count = click_count + 1, ad_title = VALUES(ad_title), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

INSERT INTO ad_statistics (ad_id, ad_title, ad_type, position, stat_date, impression_count) VALUES (#{adId}, #{adTitle}, #{adType}, #{position}, #{statDate}, 1) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE impression_count = impression_count + 1, ad_title = VALUES(ad_title), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(stat_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS statDate, SUM(click_count) AS clickCount, SUM(impression_count) AS impressionCount FROM ad_statistics WHERE stat_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY stat_date ORDER BY stat_date ASC
SELECT ad_type AS adType, SUM(click_count) AS clickCount FROM ad_statistics WHERE stat_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND ad_type IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ad_type ORDER BY clickCount DESC
SELECT position AS position, SUM(click_count) AS clickCount FROM ad_statistics WHERE stat_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND position IS NOT NULL GROUP BY position ORDER BY clickCount DESC

SELECT ad_id AS adId, MAX(ad_title) AS adTitle, SUM(click_count) AS clickCount FROM ad_statistics WHERE stat_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY ad_id ORDER BY clickCount DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT DISTINCT ad_title FROM ad_statistics WHERE stat_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND ad_title IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ad_title
